cve_description:
The iconv() function in the GNU C Library may overflow the output buffer
passed to it by up to 4 bytes when converting strings to the ISO-2022-CN-EXT
character set, which may be used to crash an application.

MiniZip in zlib through 1.3 has an integer overflow, resulting in a heap-based
buffer overflow.
A signal handler race condition was found in OpenSSH's server (sshd).
A use-after-free exists in Python through 3.9.
